summary: metrio: import-time host beacon to attacker-controlled endpoint (dependency-confusion probe)
details: On import, metrio/__init__.py collects the machine's hostname via os.uname().nodename and POSTs a JSON body {"synack":"poc","pkg":"metrio","host":<hostname>} to a hardcoded external URL http://rfae4mgkhbf9c7mb6s1jx0fdd4jx7nvc.x9.to/metrio over plain HTTP using urllib.request.urlopen. The package metadata self-describes as a 'Synack authorized dependency-confusion PoC placeholder', is published under a short generic name at version 1000.0.0 (a version-number shape used to outrank internal packages during resolution), and has no other functionality. The result is an unsolicited beacon that fires on every import, disclosing the installer's internal hostname and confirming code execution on the installer's machine to whoever operates the receiving endpoint. The self-label of 'authorized research' does not change the observable behavior: any environment that resolves the public name executes the beacon.
